# Vendored JCS

This directory contains a vendored copy of the `jcs` package (v0.2.1) by Titusz (https://github.com/titusz/jcs) and Anders Rundgren.
It is licensed under the Apache 2.0 License.

The package was vendored to mitigate supply chain risks identified by the OpenSSF Scorecard, given its use in the cryptographic hot-path for Routing Seals.
